validate_oauth2_token: validate an OAuth2 token by calling the introspection or token info endpoint and returning user auth info
check_introspection_endpoint: determine if an OAuth2 endpoint is an introspection endpoint requiring POST with client credentials
prepare_introspection_request: prepare HTTP headers and form data for an OAuth2 introspection request per RFC 7662
prepare_token_info_request: prepare HTTP headers with Bearer token for a generic OAuth2 token info GET request
extract_user_info: extract user id, user role, and team id from an OAuth2 endpoint response dictionary
